disappointing experience

I had a very disappointing experience at this surgery. I came to see Dr Pedro because I’ve been experiencing dizziness, weakness, and darkening in my eyes for several months. These symptoms are worrying and affect my daily life, but the doctor simply said “that’s normal” and offered no investigation, no blood test, no advice.
I also spoke with a woman from the management team (an Indian lady, unfortunately I didn’t get her name), but she also didn’t try to help or reassure me in any way.
The service felt completely dismissive and uncaring. I left feeling shocked and upset.
I would not recommend this GP surgery to anyone and will be changing to another
